responsibility: This is the template for the build-tree .gdbinit script used when debugging GCC. It defines numerous user commands that call GCC's in-process debug routines for trees, RTL, gimple, bitmaps, locations, and binding stacks; sets useful breakpoints and skip rules; configures pagination and signal handling; and provides a reload hook for gdbhooks.py. Its role is to establish a GCC-aware GDB environment around a compiler executable.
